sample: A sample judgment for the worked example, filled in by hand to show what a verdict looks like and what judge record does with it. It is one reading of the packet, not a model run, and another judge may answer differently. hyperspec ignores this field.

good.evidence: 29 of 41 people said their most useful one-on-one in the last quarter was one where they brought the first topic.
good.note: The central claim rests on a count from the author's own team, not on an adjective.

improve.evidence: Three is enough to hand the meeting over.
improve.note: Asserted rather than shown: nothing says why three works better than two, beyond a fourth starting to look like the manager's list.

missing.note: Who answered the survey and how it was asked is never said, so a reader cannot tell how far 41 people on one team carry.
